scope: Synthetic original-byte transport; no decoded Android or public swarm validation
environment_acceptance: Android memory pressure and decoder validation

linux_final_matrix.interpretation: Mixed performance. Combined experiments reduce blocked waits in several cases but regress the 90 Mbps burst RAM case. Adaptive alone is not consistently better than Legacy. No profile promotion.

resource_limits: Observed RSS is not the configured media-cache size or a hard process-memory ceiling.

Final matrix median RSS: about 84-94 MiB for disk cases, 1144-1201 MiB for 512 MiB RAM cache cases, 2249-2316 MiB for 2048 MiB RAM cache cases. Native/Go buffers and allocator retention remain additional costs.
Two-minute trials do not establish multi-hour memory convergence or device decoder stability.
cache_bound_acceptance: Configured media cache budget plus two-piece boundary allowance; RSS is a separate measurement
